_notes: An example idea for the MEDIUM slot. Edit it, then: admit --file <this file> --dry-run --uid <uid>, then the same with --go.
_notes is removed before anything is sent. Every other field is the idea contract (api/_utils/practiceField/contract.js).
thesis.text: what you expect and why, at most 400 characters. thesis.author: keep 'founder_fixture'.
slot: 'medium' (the positional horizon). One idea per slot per book.
names: 1 to 4 stocks of the house universe, never a fund. Here three large, liquid banks.
comparison: { type: 'sector_fund', symbols: [one fund] }. Every name must be in the fund's sector (XLF = Financials).
lines: one per name; distancePct is how far below the entry price the line sits. Medium slot: from 0.06 to 0.15.
capitalUsd: whole cents. The medium slot may reserve at most 30% of the book's marked equity ($30,000 of a new $100,000 book), and the treasury must keep 10% unreserved.
weights: optional; left out, the names are equal. origin and sources: keep as they are — the door sets a founder fixture's origin itself.

thesis.text: Large US banks keep earning a wide net interest margin while credit stays clean; over the next weeks these three should beat the financials fund.
thesis.author: founder_fixture
